title: Licensing and Regulatory Framework for Digital Banks
selection_reason: Primary regulatory framework governing digital bank licensing, operational scope, minimum capital requirements, and financial inclusion directives in Pakistan. Seed document A.
version_relationship_note: Baseline 2022 framework for digital bank licensing.

title: Consolidated Customer Onboarding Framework
selection_reason: Single consolidated regulatory baseline for account opening, digital customer onboarding, KYC/CDD procedures, and AML/CFT compliance across financial institutions. Seed document B (Base).
version_relationship_note: Original consolidated framework (BPRD Circular No. 01 of 2025); subsequently updated by BPRD Circular Letter No. 09 of 2026 (PK-SBP-AML_KYC_GUIDANCE-2026-0001).

title: Amendments to Consolidated Customer Onboarding Framework – Expansion of Roshan Digital Accounts Scope
selection_reason: Regulatory amendment expanding Roshan Digital Account (RDA) eligibility and digital onboarding scope to all non-resident natural and juridical persons. Seed document B (Amendment).
version_relationship_note: Amends BPRD Circular No. 01 of 2025 (PK-SBP-AML_KYC_GUIDANCE-2025-0001). Retained alongside the base framework to evaluate temporal/version-aware retrieval.

title: Business Conduct and Fair Treatment of Consumers Regulatory Framework (BC&FRF)
selection_reason: Mandatory regulatory standards governing fair treatment of consumers, disclosure transparency, grievance redressal, and responsible financial business conduct. Seed document C.
version_relationship_note: Current comprehensive consumer protection framework for SBP-regulated entities.

title: Revised Regulations for Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs)
selection_reason: Core regulatory regime governing Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), e-wallets, payment limits, safeguarding customer funds, and capital adequacy.
version_relationship_note: Supersedes PSD Circular No. 01 of 2019 regulations for EMIs.

title: Prudential Regulations for Corporate / Commercial Banking
selection_reason: Flagship statutory prudential regulations covering credit risk exposure limits, corporate governance, CDD/AML requirements, and operational risk for commercial banks.
version_relationship_note: Consolidated master prudential regulation booklet updated through mid-2024.

title: Prudential Regulations for Microfinance Banks (MFBs)
selection_reason: Regulatory framework governing microfinance banking operations, loan classification, provisioning requirements, and branchless banking limits.
version_relationship_note: Updated statutory Prudential Regulations for Microfinance Banks.

title: Annual Payment Systems Review FY25
selection_reason: Comprehensive official empirical report analyzing retail payments, digital payment channels, e-banking adoption, and Raast instant payment system metrics.
version_relationship_note: Annual recurring statutory payment systems review. Direct PDF endpoint requires manual headers verification.

title: Monetary Policy Statement - September 14, 2026
selection_reason: Official Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decision statement establishing key policy rate, inflation assessments, and macroeconomic outlook.
version_relationship_note: Official periodic monetary policy decision statement issued September 14, 2026.

title: Financial Stability Review 2025
selection_reason: Statutory assessment under Section 39 of SBP Act evaluating systemic financial stability, banking resilience, non-performing loans, and capital buffers.

title: Statistics on Banking System of Pakistan – June 2025
selection_reason: Authoritative statistical compilation detailing bank balance sheets, deposit structures, advance-to-deposit ratios, and sector-wise credit distribution.
version_relationship_note: Semi-annual statistical release on the Pakistani banking system.

title: Guidelines for Regulatory Sandbox
selection_reason: Official central bank guidelines establishing the operational rules, eligibility criteria, cohort themes, and testing framework for fintech innovations in Pakistan.
version_relationship_note: Final guidelines issued in May 2025 following the December 2023 draft public consultation; supersedes earlier draft consultation materials.
